in_sanskrit.name: कल्पित
in_sanskrit.meaning: to be created, to be imagined, to be planned
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is created, imagined, or planned. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kalpita', which means 'to be created', 'to be imagined', or 'to be planned'. In Hindu mythology, Kalpita is the name of a celestial nymph who was born from the mind of Lord Brahma.

in_hindi.name: कल्पित
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who is made or created. The name 'Kalpit' in Hindi translates to 'Kiya Jaana', which means 'One who is made or created'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kalpita', which means 'to be created'.

in_tamil.name: கல்பித்
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who is not known or understood. The Tamil name 'Kalpit' translates to 'Ariyavillaiyillai', which means 'One who is not known or understood'. This meaning is not directly related to the Sanskrit meaning of 'Kalpita', but it is a valid name in Tamil.

in_telugu.name: కల్పిట్
in_telugu.long_meaning: Lord of the universe. The Telugu name 'Kalpit' translates to 'Desiyoddesam', which means 'Lord of the universe'. This meaning is not directly related to the Sanskrit meaning of 'Kalpita', but it is a valid name in Telugu.

in_marathi.name: Kalpit
